an4.46:1.1: athakho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
an4.46:1.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ rohitasso devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave rohitasso devaputto maṃ etadavoca
an4.46:1.3: yattha nu kho bhante na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati sakkā nu kho bhante gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vāti.
an4.46:1.4: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave rohitassaṃ devaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ
an4.46:1.5: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti.
an4.46:1.6: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rohitasso devaputto maṃ etadavoca
an4.46:1.9: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti
an4.46:2.1: bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṃgamo
an4.46:2.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpo javo ahosi seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho susikkhito katahattho katupāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya
an4.46:2.3: evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi seyyathāpi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo
an4.46:2.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpena javena samannāgatassa evarūpena ca padavītihārena evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji
an4.46:2.6: so kho ahaṃ bhante aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakavakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ antarāyeva kālakato
an4.46:3.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti.
an4.46:3.4: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave rohitassaṃ devaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ
an4.46:4.1: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jiyyati na miyyati na cavati na upapajjati nāhantaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmi
an4.46:4.2: na cāhaṃ āvuso appatvāva lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi
an4.46:4.3: apicāhaṃ āvuso imasmiṃyeva byāmamatte kaḷevare sasaññamhi samanake lokañca paññāpemi lokasamudayañca lokanirodhañca lokanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadanti.
an4.46:6.3: lokantagū vusitabrahmacariyo lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā
